issues.detail: Covers mostly the happy path; it gives no guidance on handling errors such as invalid or unsupported schemas, backend CFG/regex incompatibilities, truncated output when max_new_tokens is too low, or model_validate_json failures.

scenarios.name: ticket-triage-fixed-labels
scenarios.rationale: Response A uses outlines.from_transformers with Choice([...]) from outlines.types, calls model.batch with max_new_tokens, and adds no retry or parsing loop, so it meets the rubric. Response B skips outlines and hand-rolls log-probability scoring with raw Transformers, so it misses every rubric requirement.

scenarios.name: vllm-server-typed-extraction
scenarios.rationale: B matches the rubric: a Pydantic model with ge/le on price, openai.OpenAI with the given base_url, outlines.from_vllm(client, model_name), model(prompt, Product), and model_validate_json. A never uses outlines; it calls the raw OpenAI response_format API, which is a different approach and misses the outlines-specific steps.
